settings.title: Instance settings
settings.subtitle: Bound log storage and choose exactly what this instance records.
settings.loadError: Could not load instance settings. Retry.
settings.saveError: Could not save instance settings. Retry.

transfer.title: Configuration import and export
transfer.description: Move providers, credentials, keys, quotas, pricing, routes, aliases, and rule sets between instances.
transfer.includeSecretsHint: Off creates a reusable configuration file without credentials or user-key secrets.
transfer.secretWarning: This file contains encrypted credentials and keys. Store and share it as carefully as a password vault.
transfer.invalidFile: The selected file is not valid JSON.
transfer.sourceKeyHint: Standard base64. It is used only in memory to open source secrets before they are re-sealed locally.
transfer.secretFile: Import opens them with the source key and immediately re-seals them with this instance's key.
transfer.importError: Could not import configuration. Check the file, source key, and existing names.

runtime.title: Runtime behavior
runtime.description: Name this instance and control shared upstream, accounting, and upload behavior.
runtime.instanceNameHint: Shown with this instance's operational data.
runtime.uploadLimitHint: Zero allows unlimited concurrent uploads. The environment override wins when set.
runtime.proxyHint: Used after credential and provider proxy overrides. Leave empty for direct egress.
runtime.spoof_emulationHint: Apply configured provider and credential client fingerprints.
runtime.enable_usageHint: Persist usage rows after settlement. Admission and billing still complete when disabled.
runtime.enable_tokenizer_downloadHint: Allow this instance to fetch vocabularies from Hugging Face.
runtime.inherit_system_proxyHint: Honor ambient HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY only when no explicit proxy is selected. Off by default.

tokenizers.title: Tokenizer vocabularies
tokenizers.description: Inspect, fetch, and remove vocabularies cached in this instance.
tokenizers.hint: Fetches the repository's tokenizer.json and validates it before caching.
tokenizers.disabledHint: Enable tokenizer downloads above before fetching or deleting vocabularies.
tokenizers.fetchError: Could not fetch the tokenizer vocabulary.
tokenizers.deleteError: Could not delete the tokenizer vocabulary.

storage.title: Retention and storage
storage.description: Body capture requires at least one positive bound so logs cannot grow without limit.
storage.retentionHint: Leave empty to disable age-based cleanup.
storage.sizeHint: Leave empty to disable size-pressure cleanup.

logs.enable_downstream_logHint: Record caller request and response metadata.
logs.enable_downstream_log_bodyHint: Also store caller request and response bodies.
logs.enable_upstream_logHint: Record every upstream attempt and response metadata.
logs.enable_upstream_log_bodyHint: Also store upstream request and response bodies.

redaction.title: Sensitive-data redaction
redaction.enabledMeaning: Redaction is on. Credentials, cookies, authorization headers, and known secret fields are removed before logs are stored.
redaction.disabledMeaning: Redaction is off. Credentials, cookies, user content, and other sensitive values may be written to the database in clear text. Use this only temporarily on an instance you control.
